items.title: Manage derailment risks to avoid Hothouse Earth
items.title_en: Manage derailment risks to avoid Hothouse Earth
items.title_zh: 管控脱轨风险，避免“温室地球”现象
items.summary_en: The risk of a ‘Hothouse Earth’ trajectory has become increasingly prominent in debates about Earth system stability and climate overshoot. Existing analyses primarily focus on biophysical feedbacks that may amplify warming beyond direct anthropogenic forcing. We argue the concept has not previously incorporated how social destabilisation lowers the effective threshold at which biophysical tipping dynamics become self-sustaining, independently of further anthropogenic forcing and so undermines the capacity for planetary stewardship. We define ‘derailment risk’ as the possibility that escalating Earth system disruption weakens the social, political, and economic conditions required to sustain mitigation, adaptation, and ecological restoration. Such risks emerge when climate impacts contribute to a wide range of challenges, including debt crises, institutional erosion, political fragmentation, supply-chain instability, and declining public support for environmental action. These reinforcing feedbacks may reduce humanity’s capacity to respond even before biophysical tipping thresholds are crossed. We therefore extend the Hothouse Earth framework by incorporating social dynamics into the Earth system stability landscape. We propose a three-stage framework for assessing and managing derailment risks: conceptual mapping of socio-biophysical feedbacks; anticipatory resilience-building interventions; responsive governance strategies for periods of escalating instability. We conclude that planetary stewardship should prioritise maintaining and expanding collective agency under worsening Earth system stress.
items.summary_zh: 在关于地球系统稳定性和气候超限的讨论中，“温室地球”轨迹的风险日益凸显。 现有的分析主要关注那些可能使变暖程度超出直接人为强迫影响的生物物理反馈。我们认为，该概念此前尚未纳入这样一个因素：即社会动荡如何降低了生物物理临界动态实现自我维持的有效阈值——这一过程独立于进一步的人为强迫，从而削弱了人类对地球的守护能力。 我们将“脱轨风险”定义为：地球系统破坏的加剧可能削弱维持减缓、适应和生态修复所需的社会、政治和经济条件。 当气候影响加剧一系列挑战时，此类风险便会出现，这些挑战包括债务危机、制度侵蚀、政治分裂、供应链不稳定以及公众对环境行动支持度的下降。这些相互强化的反馈机制可能会在生物物理临界阈值被跨越之前，就削弱人类的应对能力。 因此，我们通过将社会动态纳入地球系统稳定性格局，对“温室地球”框架进行了扩展。 我们提出了一个用于评估和管理脱轨风险的三阶段框架：对社会-生物物理反馈进行概念性映射；采取前瞻性的韧性建设干预措施；针对不稳定性加剧时期制定响应性治理策略。我们得出结论：在地球系统压力日益加剧的情况下，行星管理应优先考虑维持和扩大集体能动性。

items.title: Characterizing drinking-water facility exposure to historical wildfires in Northern Colorado
items.title_en: Characterizing drinking-water facility exposure to historical wildfires in Northern Colorado
items.title_zh: 科罗拉多州北部饮用水设施受历史野火影响情况的特征分析
items.summary_en: Wildfire increasingly threatens forested headwater watersheds that supply drinking water to downstream communities, yet current wildfire exposure assessments rarely account for inter-basin transfers (IBTs), which can expand source-water footprints beyond natural watershed boundaries and alter the hydrologic connections between fires and drinking-water intakes. Here, we developed a reproducible assessment approach to quantify historical wildfire exposure for drinking-water intakes and applied it in northern Colorado as a case study. The analysis integrated historical (1984–2024) wildfire perimeters, burn severity, subwatershed boundaries, natural hydrologic flow paths, IBT connectivity, and public water supply utility information. Across the 7,308 km2 study area, 1895 km2 burned (26% of the landscape), at least one fire occurred in 54 of the 90 watersheds examined, and approximately 31% of total burned area was classified as high severity. Across all 14 events studied, fires affected drinking-water systems serving an average of 344 854 people and four downstream intake facilities per event. Intake-level exposure depended not only on fire size, but also on burn severity and hydrologic connectivity. Incorporating IBTs altered the relative importance of individual subwatersheds in headwater areas in terms of their wildfire exposure on downstream intake systems. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for both natural and managed hydrologic connectivity in source-water wildfire exposure assessments and provide a basis for decision-support tools, such as Forests to Faucets, that directly link forest disturbance, water-supply infrastructure, and downstream communities.
items.summary_zh: 野火对为下游社区提供饮用水的森林源头流域构成的威胁日益加剧，但目前的野火风险评估很少考虑流域间调水（IBTs）——这种调水方式可能会将水源影响范围扩展到自然流域边界之外，并改变火灾与饮用水取水口之间水文联系。 在此，我们开发了一种可重复的评估方法，用于量化饮用水取水口的历史野火风险，并以科罗拉多州北部作为案例研究进行了应用。 该分析综合了历史（1984–2024年）野火边界、过火强度、子流域边界、自然水文流路径、流域间调水连通性以及公共供水设施信息。 在 7,308 平方公里的研究区域内，共有 1,895 平方公里被烧毁（占地表面积的 26%），在所考察的 90 个流域中，有 54 个至少发生过一次火灾，且总烧毁面积中约 31% 被归类为高强度火灾。 在所研究的全部14起事件中，每起事件中，火灾平均影响了为344 854人提供服务的饮用水系统以及4处下游取水设施。 取水口层面的暴露风险不仅取决于火灾规模，还取决于火势严重程度和水文连通性。纳入IBTs后，就其对下游取水系统的野火暴露风险而言，源头区域内各个子流域的相对重要性发生了变化。 这些发现突显了在水源地野火暴露评估中同时考虑自然和人为水文连通性的重要性，并为“从森林到水龙头”（Forests to Faucets）等决策支持工具提供了依据，这些工具直接将森林扰动、供水基础设施和下游社区联系起来。

items.title: Consistent drivers of lightning-ignited wildfires across global boreal forests
items.title_en: Consistent drivers of lightning-ignited wildfires across global boreal forests
items.title_zh: 全球北方林区中由雷电引发的森林火灾的共同诱因
items.summary_en: Climate change is expected to change both fire susceptibility and lightning activity in global boreal forests. The mechanics governing lightning-ignited wildfire (LIW) ignition remain, however, unclear, making predictions at global boreal scale challenging. Here we examine short-term temporal impacts of weather on ignition probability using a novel dataset on LIWs in a quasi-experimental design of ignition and non-ignition lightning pairs. Specifically, our dataset is comprised of 5251 lightning pairs coupled with temperature, precipitation, relative humidity, lightning characteristics (multiplicity, polarity, peak current, and duration) and net primary productivity. We estimate the effect of these predictor variables on ignition probability across three separate models; the full boreal, open forests and closed forests. We find a clear relationship between ignition probability and temperature, relative humidity, total precipitation, and polarity. A one standard-deviation increase in temperature (∼3.3 °C) increased ignition probability by 44%–69%, while increased precipitation and relative humidity reduced ignition probability. Both temperature and precipitation were most predictive 3–8 d before lightning and the effect lasted up to 7–11 d after lightning. Positive polarity was also associated with increased ignition likelihood. Our results suggest that LIW occurrence within the global boreal is primarily driven by short-term fire weather rather than lightning characteristics alone. A projected increase in temperatures is expected to drive ignition probability in the boreal, though this may be partly offset by an increase in total precipitation.
items.summary_zh: 预计气候变化将改变全球寒带森林的火灾易发性及雷电活动。然而，雷电引发的森林火灾（LIW）的起火机制仍不清楚，这使得在全球寒带森林范围内进行预测变得颇具挑战性。 本文利用一套关于LIW的创新数据集，通过点火与未点火闪电对的准实验设计，探讨了天气对起火概率的短期时序影响。 具体而言，我们的数据集包含5251组雷电配对数据，并结合了温度、降水、相对湿度、雷电特征（多重性、极性、峰值电流和持续时间）以及净初级生产力等变量。我们通过三个独立模型——涵盖整个北方林区、疏林和密林——估算了这些预测变量对起火概率的影响。 我们发现起火概率与温度、相对湿度、总降水量及极性之间存在明显关联。温度每增加一个标准差（约3.3 °C），起火概率会增加44%–69%，而降水量和相对湿度的增加则会降低起火概率。 在雷电发生前3–8天，温度和降水量对起火概率的预测能力最强，且这种影响可持续至雷电发生后7–11天。正极性也与起火概率增加相关。 我们的研究结果表明，全球寒带地区雷电引发森林火灾的发生主要受短期火灾天气条件驱动，而非仅由雷电特性决定。预计气温的上升将推高寒带地区的起火概率，尽管这一影响可能会因总降水量的增加而部分抵消。

items.title_en: Making ammonia at the water’s edge
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01982-wPhotocatalytic nitrogen fixation can make ammonia from nitrogen and water under mild conditions, but slow nitrogen delivery and product build-up limit output. Now, a floating solar interface couples nitrogen reduction with evaporation, greatly speeding up ammonia formation and concentrating a high-purity product in the condensate.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》（Nature Sustainability），在线发表：2026年11月6日；doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01982-w。光催化固氮可在温和条件下利用氮气和水生成氨，但氮源输送缓慢及产物积聚限制了产出。 如今，一种漂浮式太阳能界面将氮还原与蒸发相结合，大大加快了氨的生成速度，并在冷凝液中富集了高纯度的产物。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01981-xSynthesis of valuable ammonia through photocatalytic reduction of nitrogen is a promising sustainable route, but its efficiency remains limited. This work shows that coupling the reaction with solar-driven interfacial evaporation can substantially improve ammonia yield, concentration and purity.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》（Nature Sustainability），在线发表：2026年11月6日；doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01981-x 通过光催化还原氮气合成高价值氨是一种极具前景的可持续途径，但其效率仍受限。 本研究表明，将该反应与太阳能驱动的界面蒸发相结合，可显著提高氨的收率、浓度和纯度。

items.title: Carbon prices and cooking fires: how decarbonization pathway design shapes household energy burdens
items.title_en: Carbon prices and cooking fires: how decarbonization pathway design shapes household energy burdens
items.title_zh: 碳价与烹饪用火：脱碳路径的设计如何影响家庭能源负担
items.summary_en: Pathways reaching the same climate target can distribute household energy costs very differently across income groups. We compare 16 core mitigation pathways spanning a cost-optimal benchmark and technology, timing, effort-sharing, and demand-side designs, plus one rebound sensitivity, within a common integrated assessment framework. All core pathways remain below 2 °C and converge to approximately 1.5 °C warming by 2100, consistent with the Paris Agreement’s 1.5 °C temperature goal. We translate energy- and food-price outcomes into household energy burdens across income deciles in India and the United States using survey-informed downscaling. In 2030, cost-optimal, technology, and pace pathways are regressive in both countries, with larger burden increases for poorer deciles. In India, lower-demand pathways reduce global carbon prices and lower burdens for poorer households, whereas accelerated electrification and rapid traditional-biomass phase-out raise burdens. Historical-responsibility transfers lower burdens in India and raise them in the United States under the stylized transfer design. A conventional gross-income sensitivity preserves pathway rankings and almost all decile-level burden-change signs but roughly halves poorest-decile magnitudes in India. Accounting for food expenditure therefore reveals affordability pressures on poorer households that gross-income measures mute. Scenario design is an equity-relevant dimension of pathway assessment alongside revenue recycling.
items.summary_zh: 实现同一气候目标的不同路径，会在各收入群体之间造成家庭能源成本分配的显著差异。我们在一个共同的综合评估框架内，对比了16条核心减缓路径，这些路径涵盖了成本最优基准，以及技术、时间安排、减排责任分担和需求侧设计等多种方案，并包含一项“反弹效应”敏感性分析。 所有核心路径均将升温幅度控制在2 °C以下，并将于2100年收敛至约1.5 °C，这与《巴黎协定》的1.5 °C温控目标一致。 我们利用基于调查数据的降尺度方法，将能源和食品价格结果转化为印度和美国各收入十等分组家庭所承担的能源负担。到2030年，在两国，“成本最优”、“技术”和“进度”路径均呈现逆向分配特征，即收入较低的十等分组所承担的负担增幅更大。 在印度，低需求路径可降低全球碳价并减轻贫困家庭的负担，而加速电气化和快速淘汰传统生物质能则会增加负担。在简化的转移机制设计下，历史责任转移会降低印度的负担，却会增加美国的负担。 传统的总收入敏感性分析保留了路径排名和几乎所有十分位层级的负担变化符号，但在印度将最贫困十分位群体的负担幅度大致减半。因此，将食品支出纳入考量，揭示了总收入指标所掩盖的贫困家庭面临的负担能力压力。情景设计是路径评估中与公平相关的维度之一，与收入再分配同等重要。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01949-xUsing microsimulations, we quantify disaster-related decreases in material well-being, capturing not only what is damaged, but also how damage affects the population. We calculate socio-economic resilience — a population’s capacity to maintain well-being despite asset damages — and find that global well-being losses exceed US$1 trillion annually, representing about double the monetary asset damages.

weekly_insight: 近7天环境热点呈现“气候变化最为集中，生态环境与污染治理并重，政策与科研相对分散”的特点。气候变化类条目显著上升，成为讨论焦点；生态环境与污染治理虽数量适中，但关联度高，共同构成核心关注区；政策与科研学术热度相对平稳，水处理作为细分领域占比较小，整体热点分布呈现出气候与治理并行、生态支撑的格局。
